why: THE SECOND stamping site, and the one that was uncovered. There are two: `createRecordingInput` at session start and `recorder.begin` on a level advance. Measured while writing #797's coverage -- mutating this site alone left **484 of 484 loop tests passing** even with a first-level assertion on the arm in place, because a trace only reaches this path after an advance. So a run recorded across a level switch would have claimed shipped ordnance caps from level 2 onward while level 1 looked correct. Killed by extending that case through `startRestart()` and re-reading the meta.
killedBy: startGameWith: the input recorder stamps the pp1Roles ARM from the session flag, which no world can be asked for
